name: OPT Machine Vision Tech Co., Ltd.
summary: OPT Machine Vision Tech Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, manufacturing, and distribution of fundamental software and hardware components crucial for machine vision systems. Their comprehensive product range includes software development kits (SDKs), central processing units (CPUs), intelligent cameras, various illumination setups, digital current controllers, industrial-grade lenses, specialized industrial cameras, power supply units, high-speed Gigabit Ethernet cards, and an assortment of lens adapters. This firm was established on March 24, 2006, by Zhi Lin Lu and Sheng Lin Lu, with its operational base situated in Dongguan, China.
